description: This Java source file contains integration tests for client loans in the Fineract system, specifically testing non-tranche multiple disbursal scenarios, loan schedule creation, and loan status transitions.

classes.name: ClientLoanNonTrancheMultipleDisbursementsIntegrationTest
classes.description: This class contains integration tests for non-tranche multiple disbursal scenarios, including creating loan products, applying for loans, approving, disbursing, and verifying loan schedules and statuses.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes REST Assured configuration, prepares request and response specifications, and sets up the loan transaction helper.

methods.name: createLoanProduct
methods.description: Creates a loan product with specified configurations, returning its ID.

methods.name: applyForLoanApplication
methods.description: Submits a loan application for a client with specific parameters and returns the loan ID.

methods.name: checkThatNonTrancheMultiDisbursalsCreateAScheduleOnFirstDisbursalTest
methods.description: Test verifying that a non-tranche multi-disbursal loan creates a repayment schedule on first disbursal, including multiple disbursals and schedule adjustments.

methods.name: checkThatNonTrancheMultiDisbursalsCreateAScheduleOnSubmitAndApprovalTest
methods.description: Test verifying that loan schedules are created upon submission and approval for a non-tranche multiple disbursal loan.
